DEPARTMENT OF ROBOTICS & AUTOMATION
METROPOLITAN UNIVERSITY OF COMPUTING
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Arun Kumar, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2020-2024) at Metropolitan University of Computing.

During this tenure, Arun Kumar demonstrated exceptional mastery in Python, PyTorch, Distributed Systems, Kubernetes. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'Distributed Consensus in Fault-Tolerant Blockchain Networks', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Arun Kumar displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Arun Kumar among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Prof. Elena Rostova
Distinguished Professor
Robotics & Automation
Metropolitan University of Computing
Email: prof..elena.rostova@metropolit.edu
